title: Chris'sCraftingCompass
description: A mod that helps with complex or very in depth crafting trees/recipes
body:
# Chris's Crafting Compass
Tired of opening JEI, copying down ingredients, opening JEI again for those ingredients, and ending up with a half-page of paper just to plan one build? Crafting Compass does that walk for you.

Hover any item in JEI, press a key, and it gets added to your crafting list. The mod recursively traces the recipes JEI already knows about and tells you exactly what raw materials you need, and how much of each you already have.
